name: push-object
title: Push an object
signature: push(object: object_ref, direction_xy: unit_vec2, distance_m: positive_number)
description: Slide an object along its support in a direction with closed fingers: from behind when there is room, or by pressing on its top and dragging when it stands against a wall or closed edge.
use_when: An object must slide along its support without grasping it.

not_to_be_confused_with.pull: pull drags toward the base to make an object reachable.
not_to_be_confused_with.expose: expose pushes until a graspable overhang exists.
not_to_be_confused_with.separate: separate pushes away from the nearest neighbour.
not_to_be_confused_with.center: center pushes away from the support edges.
not_to_be_confused_with.roll: roll makes a cylinder rotate instead of slide.
not_to_be_confused_with.tip: tip pushes high so the object falls over.

preconditions.meaning: Base centre within 1.3 m of the place's footprint (inside the room for a room).

postconditions.meaning: Object displaced along the direction by at least half the requested distance.

failure.on_failure: stop and report the measured pre/postconditions; nothing is retried.

returns.success: true when every precondition held, the action ran and every postcondition holds
returns.error_code: on failure: INPUT_MISSING, INPUT_UNKNOWN, PRECONDITION_FAILED, NO_PATH, POLICY_FAILED, SUBSKILL_FAILED or POSTCONDITION_FAILED
returns.preconditions: each precondition as evaluated before moving, with holds = true/false
returns.postconditions: each postcondition as evaluated after the action, with holds = true/false
returns.outputs: the measured values listed under Outputs
